title: Empowering Student Mental Well-being with AI: Intelligent Journaling, Emotional Insights, and Personalized Growth
summary: StudentSphere is developing an AI journaling tool for emotional feedback, with an internal VIT pilot planned.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The proposed tool analyzes journal entries, tracks mood, and offers personalized feedback. Its planned escalation workflow would involve counselors when high-risk content appears. Accuracy and response-time figures are development targets. No observed improvement in student well-being or completed crisis intervention is reported.
purpose: Support emotional awareness and timely access to mental-health assistance.

ratings.reason: StudentSphere journaling is under development with a VIT pilot planned; accuracy and response-time figures are targets.
Counselor escalation is a proposed workflow, not a documented intervention.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 23: Empowering Student Mental Well-being with AI: Intelligent Journaling, Emotional Insights, and Personalized Growth

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: AI journaling aims to support student mental well-being
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
